title: Queen endings
intro: In queen endings checks fly in every direction. Look for the check that also attacks something: a skewer, or a mate.

lessons.title: Checks that win the queen
lessons.summary: Check the king and take what stands behind it.

steps.text: Black's king on h5 and queen on h2 stand on the same file. A check on that file must be answered by the king, and then the queen behind it falls. That is a skewer.

steps.ifWrong: Give check on h7: the king and the queen share the h-file.
steps.ifRight: The king moved and the queen fell.

steps.text: Here a check leaves the black king with no squares at all.
steps.hint: The back rank: g7 and h7 are blocked by Black's own pawns.
steps.ifRight: Qe8 blocks, but Qxe8 is mate.
